x: "Snowy" Brooks has started making his presence felt early this year, for on January 27th during an indoor 'half-decathlon' at Cosford, he chalked up a win with 3453 pts.
"Snowy" Brooks competed in the National Championships of Barbados with considerable success. He won both hurdle races with 15.9 and 56.0 and also reached 4th place in the 100m final with 10.9.
Only a few hours after he had stepped off the jet from Barbados, "Snowy" Brooks was making his mark on the meeting with a good shot putt win in a personal best distance.

We picked up some good points on the field where although we were short handed, luck was with us for a change. Bill Couzens and an injured John Martin backed up our mainstay "Snowy" Brooks in the throws and kept the score moving along nicely.

Decathlete Reg Hopkins followed the example set by "Snowy" Brooks last year and pluckily completed the course with several others behind him - a task that is far from easy for a man whose frame is packed with the sort of muscle that is more at home in the arena.

That man "Snowy" Brooks, now a Life Member of the Club, doesn't let up does he. In the Sheffield Veteran Games on June 30th he took first place in the V45 high jump, pole vault and discus with 1.50/3.00/43.52.
